reply.summary: Aueonnel is a white-haired city dweller with a quiet life among the crowds of a large port metropolis. Aueonnel has no special gifts and makes a brief appearance in a street-level tale.

feats.scene: Aueonnel shoves a stuck cafe door open with his palm.
Aueonnel stumbles on a kerb and catches himself unhurt.

reply.summary: Saslaeru is a blond alien spy from a hawk-people world who hides in plain sight as a museum painter while her squad plots to conquer the planet. Saslaeru escapes a ship explosion, takes a human name, and uses the strength and senses of her kind.

feats.scene: Saslaeru smashes a display case and crushes the thick glass in her fist.
Saslaeru crawls from the burning wreck of a star cruiser and slips into the night.

reply.summary: Oriia is a bald, grey-skinned mind-reader who feeds on dread and can make victims see monsters born from their own terror. Oriia reshapes his appearance through pure thought and haunts a city by night.

feats.scene: Oriia fills a crowded cafe with a shared vision of crawling shadows and empties it in seconds.
Oriia takes a heavy blow to the jaw and chuckles through the pain.

reply.summary: Nuros is a surly low-born thug raised in a crowded slum and drafted into a unit of convicts during a world war. Nuros says almost nothing, handles rifles and knives, and wears a perpetual scowl.

feats.scene: Nuros shoots a sentry from far across a field and drops him in one shot.
Nuros wades out of a ditch after a mortar blast and keeps on marching.

reply.summary: Cocoso is a towering grey-haired woman with huge arms built from woven cybernetic fibres and one missing eye. Cocoso pounds opponents flat with electrically driven muscle and tears fixtures out of walls.

feats.scene: Cocoso punches through a brick wall and folds a steel locker in half.
Cocoso is struck with a thrown lamp post and does not stagger.

reply.summary: Rasil is a tiny rodent officer who rides with a mounted patrol in a miniature kingdom and spies on a giant's apartment with his partner. Rasil dies impaled by a thrown blade but urges his friend to push on.

feats.scene: Rasil jabs his needle-sword into a pantry crate and slashes the lid.
Rasil is pinned to the floorboards by a thrown carving knife.

reply.summary: Cilenuve is a young volunteer in a band of demon-fighters based in a small mountain town. Cilenuve gives his life in a single battle against hellish invaders.

feats.scene: Cilenuve swings a blessed axe into a horned fiend and drives it back.
Cilenuve holds a doorway against a surge of demons until he falls.

reply.summary: Teceslo is a one-eyed pirate warlord who strangles the trade routes of a mountainous region with bandit armies and an air base. Teceslo makes every merchant pay a toll and swears to take everything down with him when beaten.

feats.scene: Teceslo blows up his own airborne fortress to spite the airmen who overran it.
Teceslo fights on through a gunfight against a squadron of flyers before he falls.

reply.summary: Ratilamo is a brown-haired warrior from a hawk-people planet, his body reinforced with metal implants. Ratilamo is the grim brother of a famous flier and fights until he falls.

feats.scene: Ratilamo drives his armoured fist through the hull of a skiff and bends the frame.
Ratilamo takes a plasma burst to the chest and stays upright.

reply.summary: Antara is a tall prisoner who can pop his limbs free from his body and steer them by thought. Antara joins a doomed mission team sent to wreck a secret experiment on an island nation.

feats.scene: Antara sends a detached fist across a courtyard and knocks a guard cold.
Antara is hit by gunfire and gathers his limbs back to stand up.

reply.summary: Lerrni is a soldier changed by military experiments into a fish-faced hybrid with claws, fangs and deep-sea toughness. Lerrni is fast enough to snatch bullets from the air and is part of a team sent to kill a sea king, but is captured.

feats.scene: Lerrni tears through a submarine hatch with his claws and drags a guard out.
Lerrni sinks to the ocean floor under crushing pressure and swims on.
Lerrni snatches a rifle round from the air.

reply.summary: Retesrnu is an orange-haired android built as an assassin and styled like a circus jester. Retesrnu thinks every performer is a hunter after him, and his head keeps working and joking after being knocked from its body.

feats.scene: Retesrnu lashes out his long tongue and yanks a clown off a stage.
Retesrnu's head is knocked clean off and keeps telling jokes.

reply.summary: Sanasam is a colossal white-eyed bird of the cosmos dispatched by high judges to seal a rogue goddess's stolen power inside a barrier. Sanasam's might is seemingly boundless, and he vanishes into the fabric of existence once the sentence is done.

feats.scene: Sanasam spreads vast wings and seals a goddess and her hoarded power inside a wall at the edge of creation.
Sanasam stands unmoved against the full onslaught of a god's army.

reply.summary: Rniliu is a blue-haired toy maker whose products were so dangerous that a rich rival closed his firm down. Rniliu swears revenge, builds gadgets, flies small aircraft, and runs a business.

feats.scene: Rniliu sets off a giant wind-up robot that stomps through a toy warehouse.
Rniliu takes a punch from a masked hero and goes sprawling.

reply.summary: Vorlleleo is a racer of the stars who belongs to a team of scientists in a sketchbook cast. Vorlleleo is quick and cheerful and appears only in a brief page of concept art.

feats.scene: Vorlleleo slams his boots on the pedals and launches his craft off the line.
Vorlleleo tears across an orbit course in his racing craft.

reply.summary: Eoneoau is a brown-haired adventurer who champions his homeland as a grim night-hunter among a cavalry of silent riders. Eoneoau slits an enemy's throat in the last battle and dies when the world's armies drop a nuclear strike.

feats.scene: Eoneoau slashes a blade across the neck of a hulking enemy champion.
Eoneoau is caught in the fireball of an atomic weapon and dies in it.

reply.summary: Iartilcor is a bald, grey-haired old spy who went rogue from a fallen empire and plans to poison a huge city's water supply. Iartilcor hides radioactive metal in a monument and coats himself in it, but is stopped and sent home.

feats.scene: Iartilcor plans to dump a statue's worth of toxic metal into a reservoir that serves millions.
Iartilcor is tackled by two agents and bundled into a van.

reply.summary: Elveo is a yellow-skinned guard in a galactic police corps who watches over caged scientists and secretly loves one of his prisoners. Elveo defies the chaos of an assault by staying at his post, and a ring chooses his beloved because of her feelings for him.

feats.scene: Elveo moulds a glowing cage from his ring and traps a rampaging inmate inside.
Elveo raises a green shield over the cell block and holds it against falling rubble.

reply.summary: Vaustva is a red-haired explosives expert and field operative who is not really from the land his nickname suggests and speaks several languages. Vaustva loses an arm to a hunting machine on a mission and recovers in bed with a comrade.

feats.scene: Vaustva sets a charge that collapses a bunker roof on a squad of guards.
Vaustva survives having his arm sliced off by a robot and lives to tell it.

reply.summary: Neoor is a dark-haired gentleman burglar who targets galleries and is caught by a ghostly boy and his keeper in one tale. Neoor is a skilled thief with no powers.

feats.scene: Neoor swings a sack of loot into a night guard's stomach.
Neoor drops from a gallery window to the pavement and limps off.

reply.summary: Naloluin is a white-skinned bloodsucker with no hair who serves a revived regime of tyrants. Naloluin uses the abilities of the undead and fights in the open at night.

feats.scene: Naloluin hurls a parked car through a shop front.
Naloluin is shot through the chest and keeps walking toward his target.
Naloluin crosses an alley in a blur to seize a guard.

reply.summary: Tilulnas is a fair-haired noble general who commands a huge army for a conquering emperor, and gives his enemies a fair chance to surrender. Tilulnas launches a full assault at dawn and is killed by an enchanted spear sent hunting for him.

feats.scene: Tilulnas charges a stone gatehouse at the head of an army and splits the doors with his lance.
Tilulnas rides through a hail of arrows with his shield raised.

reply.summary: Anstucol is a fake noble who cons rich society guests with a bogus relief fund and a hired killer in disguise. Anstucol knocks a masked hero unconscious from behind before the plot unravels.

feats.scene: Anstucol clubs a rival over the head with a heavy candlestick.
Anstucol is shoved down a short flight of steps and gets up grumbling.

reply.summary: Leorer is a black-haired foreign agent who dabbles in rainbow tricks and clashes once with a boy hero in a single story. Leorer is a minor adversary with a flair for colour.

feats.scene: Leorer sprays a coloured mist into a pursuer's face and runs.
Leorer is knocked into a wall and lands in a heap.

reply.summary: Stota is a brown-haired aristocrat-scientist who works in secret behind a masked identity and fights an insect-themed hero. Stota builds gadgets in a hidden lab and strikes from behind a mask.

feats.scene: Stota fires an experimental device that scorches a lab bench.
Stota is thrown against a console and shrugs off the bruise.

reply.summary: Tervaani is a fair-haired sorcerer who travelled into a legendary court and became the mage who guards a piece of a holy relic. Tervaani heals mortal wounds with an old protective charm, fights with a bo staff and flies with a glowing staff that gathers starlight.

feats.scene: Tervaani fires a blast of gathered starlight from her staff that shatters a stone tower.
Tervaani weathers a dragon's fire behind a shimmering ward.

reply.summary: Nesnoer is a blond schoolgirl who finds a magic belt in her stepdad's old things and takes up hero work, later gaining a glowing staff. Nesnoer favours high kicks and complains that class is a waste of time.

feats.scene: Nesnoer swings her staff and smashes a parked car's windshield and roof.
Nesnoer is flung into a fence and gets right up.

reply.summary: Sieoneon is an apprentice mage who draws on starlight through a magic staff and swears vengeance after her master is slain. Sieoneon speaks for her fellow wizards when a warlord tries to recruit them for his crusade.

feats.scene: Sieoneon channels starlight through her staff and blows a boulder to gravel.
Sieoneon takes a blast from a rival mage and holds her ground.

reply.summary: Nananu is a blond young hero from a doomed parallel world who carries a glowing staff. Nananu is apparently killed shortly before her whole universe is destroyed.

feats.scene: Nananu fires a bolt from her staff that topples a lamp post.
Nananu is caught in the collapse of her world and dies in the wreckage.

reply.summary: Valon is a blond teen hero who finds a staff, belt and starred shirt in a box of old gear and decides to try them on. Valon becomes a stubborn member of several teams who refuses to quit, gaining flight and bolts of force from the staff.

feats.scene: Valon aims her staff at a bridge pillar and blasts a house-sized chunk of concrete away.
Valon is tossed through a warehouse wall and rises from the rubble.
Valon races over a skyline on her staff to catch a falling cable car.

reply.summary: Allria is a blond teenager from a farming town who fashions a costume from a dead hero's gear to annoy her stepdad. Allria is mentored by the old hero and trained by a speedster, eventually fighting alongside a youth team.

feats.scene: Allria blasts a bolt of starlight from her staff and buckles a truck door.
Allria is thrown into a barn wall and keeps fighting.

reply.summary: Orace is a fifteen-year-old schoolgirl who picks up a fallen hero's mantle and leads a revived team of masked champions. Orace uses a starlit staff and believes strongly that there is good in everyone, even after a dark spirit tries to prove otherwise.

feats.scene: Orace fires a blast from her staff that destroys a delivery van.
Orace is thrown through a classroom wall and stands back up.

reply.summary: Arton is a brown-and-white trickster spirit of folk tales who takes a thousand shapes and disguises himself as a young sidekick to fool a caped hero. Arton agrees to guide the hero when exposed, and boasts that he will baffle his foes again.

feats.scene: Arton shifts into a hawk and snatches a hat from a passerby's head.
Arton is caught in a net and slips out in the shape of a mouse.

reply.summary: Iarreniu is a gunslinger who loves causing pain, then gives it up for a farm and a family until the walking dead eat them. Iarreniu bargains with four wind spirits for endless life and hunts monsters across the plains.

feats.scene: Iarreniu empties both revolvers into a mob of the undead and drops a dozen of them.
Iarreniu tears free of fence ropes that held him and heals his wounds overnight.

reply.summary: Celmecel is a trickster god who takes the shape of an elderly desert elder and guides lost souls. Celmecel is the sibling of many animal spirits, and travels from the spirit plane to a sprawling western city.

feats.scene: Celmecel shakes the desert floor and splits a canyon wall in a burst of laughter.
Celmecel is dropped from a cliff and stands up as a coyote, grinning.

reply.summary: Irnso is a bald racketeer who demands ransom from a metropolis and blows up a building full of officers to prove he means it. Irnso is beaten almost to death by a masked clock-themed vigilante and his young helper.

feats.scene: Irnso detonates a charge that destroys an entire police building.
Irnso is pounded in a fistfight and left barely conscious.

reply.summary: Stinum is a blond traveller who stumbles onto a robbery outside a bank and easily beats two men, then watches the victim run off. Stinum appears in a single page and is remembered as the first of a publisher's creations.

feats.scene: Stinum floors two muggers in a few swings.
Stinum gets shoved into a lamp post and brushes himself off.

reply.summary: Anrase is a reformed crook who serves in a band of wartime commandos. Anrase uses a criminal's skills for the good side and takes on risky raids behind enemy lines.

feats.scene: Anrase picks a lock and slips a grenade into an enemy bunker.
Anrase crawls through barbed wire under rifle fire and comes out scratched.

reply.summary: Osastta is a surly teenager in a flashy fur coat and heavy jewellery who wears a screen mask that shows his true mood as a text face. Osastta cannot lie because of the mask, which also stands in for his ruined eyes.

feats.scene: Osastta shoves an elder out of the way and the screen flashes an angry face.
Osastta is shut in a cell and the mask shows a sad face, but he is unharmed.

reply.summary: Aunrn is a dark-blond student two years younger than his schoolmates because he skipped grades. Aunrn writes for the school paper, solves problems with his brain and escapes groups of attackers unhurt.

feats.scene: Aunrn dodges a swung bat and shoves a bully to the ground.
Aunrn is cornered by several boys and slips away without a scratch.

reply.summary: Rnvarn is a black-haired strongman who flies, lifts huge weights and resists hard blows, a pastiche of a famous caped hero. Rnvarn loses his strength to a blue hum and can be killed by violent noise.

feats.scene: Rnvarn flips a bus over a street and sends it skidding through a plaza.
Rnvarn is hit by a truck in the street and is barely scuffed.

reply.summary: Iumsint is a bald black-eyed bird who brags that he is the cleverest of his kind and schemes against a team of farm-fresh heroes. Iumsint's plans keep getting overruled by a duller colleague, ending with him covered in corn.

feats.scene: Iumsint pecks at a lock and rattles the latch loose.
Iumsint is buried in spilled grain and pops his head out.
Iumsint flaps away from a chasing tail in a panic.

reply.summary: Oluca is a severed head rooted to a living hand, created by a wicked mage-scientist during a war, who later takes a spare body and passes as a doctor. Oluca treats the borrowed torso as a footstool and the original body acts on its own.

feats.scene: Oluca scuttles across a table on his hand and bites a technician's wrist.
Oluca is dropped down a laboratory stairwell and rolls to a stop, grumbling.

reply.summary: Saueonor is a mysterious menace who appears briefly in a two-hero tale and is known only by a single violent nickname. Saueonor smashes things and leaves little behind.

feats.scene: Saueonor rams a delivery truck into a storefront and tears out the front wall.
Saueonor takes a crash through a barrier and climbs out of the wreck.

reply.summary: Telst is a young man who works with a team of vigilante allies in a shared comic universe. Telst gets only a bare entry, and nothing is recorded of his deeds.

feats.scene: Telst throws a quick jab at a would-be thief.
Telst takes a tumble down a flight of steps and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Aumime is a mad ship captain who sells cheap boats, sinks them with giant tentacled beasts, salvages them and sells them again. Aumime thinks this beats the same trick with cars, and he is quite unhinged.

feats.scene: Aumime orders a giant squid to crush a rowing boat to splinters.
Aumime is dunked off his own deck and climbs back up laughing.

reply.summary: Coaneti is a dark-haired former crook who talks his way into a post as the fashion teacher at a school for young heroes, despite fibbing on his application. Coaneti joined a reform programme after a stitching contest.

feats.scene: Coaneti swats a sewing mannequin across a classroom.
Coaneti falls off a runway stage and tidies his coat.

reply.summary: Oneiuna is a patchwork-dressed menace who wears a bright, dazzling helmet and clashes with a league of heroes in a cartoon world. Oneiuna uses the helmet's flashing lights to disorient opponents.

feats.scene: Oneiuna fires a dazzling burst from his helmet that blinds a squad of guards.
Oneiuna is tackled by a speedster and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Anauti is a bald, blue-skinned alien mastermind who commands servants intent on fusing two parallel worlds into one. Anauti uses a captive android as an anchor to dissolve the barrier between them, which stuns heroes on both sides at once.

feats.scene: Anauti drives energy through his captive until the wall between two worlds crumbles.
Anauti stands unharmed as his machinery howls around him.

reply.summary: Retumreo is a subterranean beast grown to monstrous height by a stolen serum, which stomps into a populated city carrying an atomic bomb. Retumreo is sent down a sinkhole where the bomb finally kills it.

feats.scene: Retumreo stomps through a district and flattens several blocks of low buildings.
Retumreo is killed only when the atomic weapon goes off deep beneath it.
